title: setup hook --harness codex writes .codex/hooks.json with the same three JITSO groups as Claude Code and notes the Codex trust step
source: intended: setup hook for every harness (claude, codex, opencode, pi): one plan, one preview, one confirmation and one backup
intent: INTENDED behavior. Codex reads project hooks from `.codex/hooks.json`, in the schema of Claude Code's `hooks` object, and sends Claude-shaped hook input, so `jitso setup hook --harness codex --yes` writes the canonical file Claude Code gets (PreToolUse `Bash` and `mcp__.*orca.*__.*`, SessionEnd, each `jitso hook guard`). Only the chosen harness is touched (no `.claude`). After the write it notes that Codex runs project hooks only in a trusted project, after the owner approves them in Codex; a second run is nothing to do and prints no note.

stdout: note: commit .codex/hooks.json so linked worktrees and other clones get the guard
note: Codex runs project hooks only in a trusted project, after you approve them in Codex (/hooks)
stderr: jitso: warning: jitso is not on PATH, so the hook cannot start until it is (the guard then lets every call through)

stdout.equals: jitso setup hook: nothing to do (the guard is already registered in .codex/hooks.json)
